title: Juliette Has A Gun Not a Perfume Superdose EDP 100ml Unisex
description:
Not a Perfume Superdose by Juliette Has A Gun is a niche perfume and one of the house's most talked-about concepts - a minimalist, one-molecule fragrance built entirely around cetalox (amber/ambroxan) - the 'superdose' intensifies the effect for a stronger, longer-lasting version of the brand's famous single-note concept. It reads differently on every skin, ranging from a clean skin scent to a warm, woody-musky presence. Hypoallergenic by design, with no traditional multi-note pyramid.

As an Eau de Parfum, it's designed for long wear, and because it works with your own skin chemistry, the exact result varies from person to person.

100ml Eau de Parfum.
